_comment: Curated venue labels for the arkham-intel endpoints. Only add an entry you can point at a public source for — the endpoints publish these as attributed names, and an unverified label would be a false claim. Empty or missing entries are reported to the buyer as 'no label', never as 'clean'.

<address>.label: human name
<address>.type: cex | bridge | mixer | marketplace | sanctioned | exploit | dex | token | treasury | other
<address>.source: where this label comes from (official docs URL, announcement, filing)

0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda029.label: USDC on Base
0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda029.source: Circle's published USDC contract address for Base
